sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/PELICAN & OLMORAN TENTED/PELICAN LODGE & OLMORAN TENTED CAMP 2026 CONTRACT RATES.pdf
notes: Both a Non-Resident 'Net Rate' (Sunworld's contract rate) AND a separate Non-Resident 'Rack Rate' (all-year-round, no seasonality) are given - unusual to have both in one document.

ANOMALY: The Kenyan Citizens/Residents rate table has two visible date typos: 'Peak' row date range reads '1st Jul 2026-31st Oct 2025\6' (garbled) and '23rd Dec 20246-1st Jan 2027' (extra digit) - clearly OCR/typing errors in the source, not corrected, but the associated rate figures (KES13,000/17,500/22,500) are unambiguous and used as-is.
Resident rates commissionable at 15% (vs Pelican Lodge's 10% - these are two different contracts despite being in the same PDF).

seasons.peak: 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026, 23 Dec 2026-1 Jan 2027 (dates garbled in source, see top-level notes)

childPolicy.raw: Below 3 years sharing with 2 parents: free. 3-9 years sharing with 2 parents: 50% of per-person sharing rate. One kid sharing with one adult: double rate. 10+ considered adults. Exclusive use of tented room: 100% of contract rate.

easterChristmasSupplement.raw: NO Easter supplement. Christmas (24,25,26,31 Dec 2026 & 1 Jan 2027): Non-Resident US$30/person, US$20/child; Resident KES2,000/person, KES1,500/child.

meals.item: Bush dinner (min 4 people, incl. outside setup, bottle of wine, bonfire)

activities.item: Full day Game Drive/return airstrip transfers (minivan, pop-up roof)
Full day Game Drive/return airstrip transfers (Land Cruiser)

singleRoomPolicy.raw: Max 2 single rooms at single rate per booking, rest at double rate.

groupReward.raw: 1 free pax per 15 paying clients, not applicable during promotional periods.

policies.releasePeriod: Block bookings confirmed via 50% deposit at time of booking; room lists min 30 days prior to arrival
policies.deposit: 50% deposit on confirmation, balance 30 days prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: 75-50 days: 25% of applicable rate per bed-night; 49-37 days: 50%; within 36 days or no-show: 100%
policies.invoiceDispute: Must be raised within 4 days of invoicing
